questions.stem: A 33-year-old man presents with a gunshot wound. The entry site is at the gluteal region and the exit site is at the femoral region. Which of the following structures is most likely injured?

A newborn presents with continuous clear fluid discharge from the umbilicus. Laboratory analysis confirms that the fluid contains elevated creatinine levels. Imaging reveals a patent tubular connection between the urinary bladder and the umbilicus. This condition results from failure of which embryologic structure to properly obliterate?

A newborn infant presents with persistent clear fluid discharge from the umbilicus. The fluid is noted to have the odor of urine. Imaging reveals a patent tubular connection between the urinary bladder and the umbilicus. This condition results from failure of which of the following structures to obliterate?

A full-term newborn presents with ambiguous external genitalia. Karyotype analysis reveals 46,XY. Physical examination shows bilateral undescended testes. Pelvic ultrasonography demonstrates the presence of a uterus and upper vagina. Which of the following genetic abnormalities is the most likely cause of this condition?

A 58-year-old man with type 2 diabetes mellitus has been taking metformin, NSAIDs, and hydrochlorothiazide. He is recently diagnosed with chronic kidney disease (CKD). Laboratory studies show progressive renal impairment. Which of the following metabolic processes is most likely impaired due to chronic kidney disease?

A full-term newborn has ambiguous external genitalia. Karyotype analysis reveals 46,XY. Pelvic ultrasound shows streak gonads and the presence of a uterus. Serum testosterone level is very low. Which of the following genetic defects is the most likely cause of this condition?
While performing a pelvic exenteration, the surgical oncologist notices a fractured or ruptured boundary of the pelvic inlet. Which of the following structures is most likely damaged?

A newborn is found to have a 46,XY karyotype. The presence of a specific gene on the Y chromosome initiates testicular differentiation during embryologic development. Which of the following genes is located on the Y chromosome and is primarily responsible for initiating male sex determination?

A patient is newly diagnosed with diabetes mellitus. His glomerular filtration rate (GFR) increases from 100 mL/min to 140 mL/min. Which of the following mechanisms most likely explains this increase in GFR?

choices.D: Increased hydrostatic pressure in glomerular capillaries
choices.E: Increased hydrostatic pressure in Bowman’s capsule

questions.stem: A 40 yrs old man complained of frequent urination, after measuring his renal function ,to GFR to be 140 mL/min, his plasma glucose was 180 mg/dL,if renal transport maximum for glucose is normal. what would be this patient’s approximate rate of urinary glucose excretion

A 42-year-old man presents with severe dehydration due to prolonged vomiting. He reports decreased urine output. Laboratory findings show elevated serum sodium and increased plasma osmolarity. Which of the following best describes the ratio of tubular fluid osmolarity to plasma osmolarity (TF/P) in the proximal convoluted tubule in this patient?

A 12-year-old boy presents with facial puffiness and dark-colored urine two weeks after recovering from a sore throat. Laboratory studies show hematuria and mild proteinuria. Serum complement levels are decreased. Which of the following mechanisms best explains the presence of albumin in this patient’s urine?

choices.A: Decreased sodium reabsorption in the proximal tubule
choices.B: Increased synthesis of albumin in the liver
choices.C: Loss of negative charge in the glomerular basement membrane
choices.D: Increased beta-oxidation in renal tubular cells

questions.stem: A 28-year-old pregnant woman delivers her baby before reaching the hospital and incurs a posterior vaginal tear. A pudendal nerve block is necessary to adequately anesthetize the area to facilitate proper closure of the wound. If this block is performed transvaginally, which landmark can be palpated in order to determine the proper site of anesthetic injection?

A 27-year-old man presents with generalized weakness. Laboratory studies reveal the following: Na⁺ = 140 mEq/L, K⁺ = 5 mEq/L, Cl⁻ = 118 mEq/L, HCO₃⁻ = 12 mmol/L, Creatinine = 1 mg/dL, Arterial pH = 7.2 Which of the following acid–base disturbances is most consistent with these findings?

choices.B: Metabolic acidosis with high anion gap
choices.C: Metabolic acidosis with normal anion gap

questions.stem: A 62-year-old man presents with painless gross hematuria and unintentional weight loss for 3 months. He also reports intermittent right flank discomfort. CT scan of the abdomen reveals an irregular, contrast-enhancing mass in the right kidney. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

choices.C: Transitional cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis

questions.stem: A 55-year-old man undergoes sacral surgery for removal of a presacral mass. Postoperatively, he develops difficulty initiating urination and reports a sensation of incomplete bladder emptying. Neurologic examination reveals impaired autonomic function affecting the lower urinary tract. Damage to which of the following nerves is most likely responsible for this condition?
The micturition reflex involves coordinated autonomic and somatic control of the bladder and urethral sphincters. Which of the following actions would inhibit the micturition reflex?

choices.C: Stimulation of adrenergic receptors at the detrusor muscle
choices.E: Inhibition of parasympathetic activity at the external urethral sphincter

questions.stem: A 37-year-old woman complains of a bearing-down sensation in her pelvis along with increased urinary frequency and dysuria. On pelvic examination, she is diagnosed with uterine prolapse. Which of the following structures provides the primary support for the cervix of the uterus?

A 20-year-old Thai male presents with persistent headache. His blood pressure is 160/110 mmHg. Urinalysis shows: Protein 1+ , WBC 1–2/HPF , RBC 10–20/HPF , Dysmorphic red blood cells Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A 13-year-old girl presents with progressive periorbital edema and frothy urine for 2 weeks. She has no history of recent infection. Blood pressure is normal. Urinalysis shows: 4+ protein , No hematuria, No glucosuria, Serum creatinine is 2.1 mg/dL. Renal biopsy demonstrates sclerosis involving portions of approximately 50% of the glomeruli. Immunofluorescence is negative for immune complex deposition. Electron microscopy shows effacement of podocyte foot processes in affected areas. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

An 8-year-old boy presents with facial puffiness and dark-colored urine. Two weeks ago, he had a sore throat that resolved without treatment. On examination, he has mild periorbital edema and elevated blood pressure. Urinalysis shows hematuria and mild proteinuria. Which of the following investigations would most likely support the underlying diagnosis?

An autopsy of a 58-year-old man reveals bilaterally small kidneys with a coarsely granular surface. Histologic examination shows: Glomerulosclerosis , Tubular atrophy , Interstitial fibrosis Some dilated tubules. Which of the following clinical findings is most likely associated with this condition?

A 60-year-old man with a 35-pack-year smoking history presents with painless gross hematuria for 2 weeks. He denies flank pain or fever. Physical examination is unremarkable.Urinalysis confirms numerous red blood cells without significant proteinuria. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
A patient presents to the emergency department with persistent vomiting for several days. Which of the following is the most likely compensatory response of the body?

A 30-year-old man with type 1 diabetes mellitus presents with polyuria and altered consciousness. His blood glucose level is 400 mg/dL. Arterial blood gas shows: pH = 7.1, HCO₃⁻ = 10 mmol/L Which of the following renal mechanisms is most likely increased in response to this condition?

A patient is evaluated for acid–base disturbance with the following laboratory values: Na⁺ = 140 mEq/L, K⁺ = 5 mEq/L, Cl⁻ = 120 mEq/L, HCO₃⁻ = 11 mmol/L, Creatinine = 1 mg/dL, pH = 7.2 Which of the following best describes this condition?

choices.B: Metabolic acidosis with high anion gap
choices.C: Metabolic acidosis with normal anion gap
choices.E: Respiratory acidosis with normal anion gap

questions.stem: Given the following data: GFR = 120 mL/min Plasma HCO₃⁻ = 10 mmol/L Urine HCO₃⁻ = 0 mmol/L Titratable acid excretion = 25 mmol/L NH₄⁺ excretion = 20 mmol/L What is the amount of new HCO₃⁻ generated?

A 78-year-old man presents with dysuria and low-grade fever. Urinalysis shows pyuria. Urine culture results are as follows: Staphylococcus spp.: 20,000 CFU/mL Delftia acidovorans: >100,000 CFU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation of these findings?

choices.A: The specimen is inadequate for interpretation

questions.stem: A 76-year-old man presents with dysuria and urinary frequency. Urinalysis shows pyuria and no significant squamous epithelial cells. Urine culture reveals the following: Delftia acidovorans: >100,000 CFU/mL Staphylococcus aureus: 20,000 CFU/mL Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?
A 10-year-old girl, large amount watery diarrhea, PR 100/min, RR 20/min, BP (Supine) 90/60 mmHg, BP (Standing) 80/50 mmHg. What is likely increase by physiological renin secretion?

A 50-year-old man with liver cirrhosis presents with progressive oliguria. Laboratory tests show low serum creatinine despite signs of advanced kidney dysfunction. Accurate assessment of kidney function is required. Which of the following equations provides the most reliable estimation of GFR in this patient?
A 57-year-old women with underlying DM and HT was admitted due to generalized edema. Her urine becomes frothy. The fatty cast and oval fat bodies was found in microscopic examination in urinalysis

choices.D: urine protein 320 mg/dl, urine creatinine 80 mg/day
choices.E: urine protein 7.2 mg/dl, urine creatinine 60 mg/dl

questions.stem: A 24-year-old woman presents with dysuria, urinary urgency, and suprapubic pain for 2 days. She denies flank pain or vaginal discharge. Physical examination reveals mild suprapubic tenderness. Urine culture shows growth of 10⁵ CFU/mL of Staphylococcus saprophyticus. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation?

A 50-year-old woman presents with fever and cloudy urine. Urinalysis shows: WBC 50–100/HPF, RBC 1–2/HPF, Serum creatinine = 3 mg/dL, both hemoculture and urine bacterial culture are negative. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her fever?

A 35-year-old man presents with facial edema and hypertension. Urinalysis reveals: Specific gravity: 1.020, pH: 6.5, Glucose: negative, Leukocyte esterase: negative Microscopic examination shows dysmorphic red blood cells. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
Hypercalcemia can increase the risk of nephrolithiasis. Which of the following mechanisms help prevent kidney stone formation in this condition?

choices.C: Increased number of aquaporin type 1 channels via calcium-sensing receptors (CaSR)
choices.E: Decreased number of aquaporin type 2 channels mediated by CaSR

questions.stem: A 58-year-old man with hypercalcemia presents with polyuria and polydipsia. Laboratory results: Serum osmolality: 305 mOsm/kg , Urine osmolality: 120 mOsm/kg After administration of desmopressin, urine osmolality shows minimal change. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
A urine specimen is left at room temperature for 4 hours before analysis. Which of the following changes is most likely to be observed?

A 35-year-old man is brought to the emergency department after a motor vehicle accident. He is hypotensive and tachycardic. Imaging reveals a pelvic fracture with a rapidly expanding pelvic hematoma. Which of the following arteries is the most likely source of bleeding?

A 24-year-old male bodybuilder presents for a routine health check. He reports using protein supplements and over-the-counter performance-enhancing products for muscle gain. Laboratory results reveal elevated serum creatinine, but his blood urea nitrogen and urinalysis are normal. He has no symptoms of kidney disease. Which of the following supplements is most likely responsible for the elevated creatinine level?
A 26-year-old woman has a perineal tear extending to the perineal body (second-degree tear). Which muscle is injured?

A 60-year-old woman presents with masses in both breasts. Physical examination reveals a 2.5-cm, firm mass with ill-defined borders. Histologic examination shows dysplastic cells infiltrating the stroma in a single-file (“Indian file”) pattern. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A 22-year-old woman presents with a painless, mobile breast mass. On physical examination, the mass is well-circumscribed and firm. Histopathologic examination reveals a well-demarcated lesion composed of abundant fibrotic and myxoid stroma with benign ductal structures embedded within the fibrous tissue. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A 54-year-old woman is diagnosed with carcinoma of the right breast. Several months later, imaging reveals metastatic involvement of the contralateral (left) breast without distant organ metastasis. Which of the following lymph node groups most likely allows spread of breast cancer from one breast to the other?

A 28-year-old man presents with bilateral breast enlargement and infertility. Physical examination reveals decreased testicular volume. Laboratory studies show elevated serum estradiol levels with suppressed LH and FSH levels. Which of the following testicular cells is most directly affected by the elevated estrogen levels, leading to impaired spermatogenesis?

A 72-year-old man presents with urinary hesitancy, weak stream, and nocturia. Digital rectal examination reveals a symmetrically enlarged, smooth prostate. He is diagnosed with benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). Which of the following medications may be used in the treatment of this condition?

A 17-year-old male presents for evaluation of delayed pubertal progression. Laboratory studies reveal normal testosterone levels. However, further evaluation shows impaired conversion of testosterone to both dihydrotestosterone (DHT) and estradiol. Which of the following physiological processes requires the combined action of both DHT and estradiol in males?

choices.A: Deepening of the voice during puberty
choices.B: Development of facial and body hair

questions.stem: A 24-year-old woman has regular menstrual cycles every 26 days. If the first day of her last menstrual period is considered day 1, on which day of her cycle is ovulation most likely to occur?

A 40-year-old man presents with severe perianal pain and swelling. Imaging reveals an abscess located in the ischiorectal (ischioanal) fossa. Which of the following nerves is located within the ischiorectal fossa and may be affected by this condition?

A 23-year-old woman presents with malodorous, frothy vaginal discharge and vulvar itching. Pelvic examination reveals a “strawberry cervix.” A wet mount preparation of the discharge shows motile, pear-shaped organisms. Which of the following is the most likely causative organism?

During the menstrual cycle, a specific ovarian cell type produces inhibin, which exerts negative feedback on the anterior pituitary to suppress follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) secretion. Which of the following cells is primarily responsible for inhibin production?

A 68-year-old man presents with urinary hesitancy, weak stream, and nocturia. Digital rectal examination reveals a symmetrically enlarged, smooth prostate. Benign prostatic hyperplasia most commonly arises from which zone of the prostate?
Which of the following is the primary clinical use of Flutamide and Bicalutamide when initiating therapy with a GnRH agonist in prostate cancer?

choices.B: Prevent tumor flare due to initial testosterone surge
choices.E: Stimulate apoptosis directly in tumor cells

questions.stem: A patient taking Desmopressin drinks excessive amounts of water. What electrolyte abnormality is most likely to occur?

A 62-year-old postmenopausal woman presents with abnormal uterine bleeding for 3 months. She denies hormone replacement therapy use. Physical examination reveals a unilateral adnexal mass. Endometrial biopsy demonstrates complex endometrial hyperplasia without atypia. Serum laboratory testing shows elevated inhibin levels. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?
In the process of spermatogenesis, which of the following cells is located in the outermost layer of the seminiferous tubule?
A Gram stain from a urethral discharge specimen reveals Gram-negative, kidney bean– shaped diplococci located inside neutrophils. Which of the following organisms is the most likely causative agent?
A 72-year-old man comes for a regular health checkup. A digital rectal examination (DRE) is performed. Which of the following structures will be most readily palpated during this examination?

A 32-year-old man presents with a painless genital ulcer that has progressively enlarged over several weeks. On examination, there is a well-demarcated, friable, bright red ulcer on the glans penis that bleeds easily on contact. Infection with Klebsiella granulomatis is most likely associated with which of the following gross findings?

choices.D: Painful soft ulcer with ragged edges

questions.stem: Which germline mutation is associated with luminal-type breast cancer?

A 55-year-old postmenopausal woman presents with abnormal uterine bleeding. Endometrial biopsy reveals endometrioid adenocarcinoma. Which of the following gene mutations is most commonly associated with this type of tumor?

A 65-year-old man with congestive heart failure is started on furosemide for volume overload. Two weeks later, he returns for follow-up laboratory testing. Which of the following electrolyte abnormalities is most commonly associated with furosemide therapy?

During the luteal phase of the menstrual cycle, granulosa cells undergo luteinization and change their pattern of hormone production. Which of the following hormones is predominantly produced by granulosa cells during the luteal phase?
A 25-year-old woman has a regular 35-day menstrual cycle. Which of the following best describes the endometrial histology on day 18 of her menstrual cycle?

choices.C: Stromal cells undergo active mitotic expansion
choices.D: Decidual cells transform into stromal cells
choices.E: Uterine glands are straight with narrow lumen

questions.stem: A 65-year-old man presents with multiple penile lesions that have been present for 2 months. Physical examination reveals shiny, soft, cauliflower-like masses on the glans penis and foreskin. Which of the following is the most appropriate diagnosis for this patient’s penile neoplasm?

A 30-year-old woman at 31 weeks’ gestation presents with regular uterine contractions and cervical dilation consistent with preterm labor. The obstetric team plans to delay delivery for 48 hours to allow administration of antenatal corticosteroids. Which of the following medications is most appropriate for tocolysis in this patient?

A 38-year-old woman presents for contraceptive counseling. She smokes 15 cigarettes per day and has a BMI of 32 kg/m². She has no history of diabetes or thromboembolic disease. Blood pressure is within normal limits. She is interested in starting a combined oral contraceptive (COC). Which of the following adverse effects is she at greatest risk of developing with COC use?
A 23-year-old woman with regular menstrual cycles is being evaluated for ovulatory function. Which of the following hormone surges is essential for ovulation?
A breastfeeding woman requests oral contraceptive pills. She also wants improvement of acne and hirsutism. Which of the following progestins is most appropriate?

A 45-year-old man is started on a new medication for hypertension. After several weeks, he reports cold extremities and fatigue. Which of the following mechanisms of action is most consistent with this adverse effect?

choices.C: β₁ selective agonist → increased heart rate

questions.stem: A 52-year-old woman with estrogen receptor–positive breast cancer is treated with fulvestrant. Which of the following best describes the mechanism of action of this medication?

choices.A: Competitive binding to estrogen receptor → prevents receptor dimerization → accelerates receptor degradation → decreases ER expression
choices.B: Selective estrogen receptor modulation with partial agonist activity in bone
choices.C: Inhibition of aromatase enzyme → decreased estrogen synthesis
choices.D: Suppression of GnRH release from the hypothalamus
choices.E: Direct inhibition of HER2 receptor tyrosine kinase

questions.stem: A 28-year-old woman at 32 weeks’ gestation presents with regular uterine contractions and cervical dilation consistent with preterm labor. She has a history of poorly controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus and is currently receiving insulin therapy. The clinical goal is to delay delivery for approximately 48 hours to allow administration of antenatal corticosteroids. Which of the following medications is the most appropriate to achieve this goal?
A 24-year-old woman has a regular 35-day menstrual cycle. On day 18 of her cycle, which hormone is most likely predominant?

A 24-year-old woman presents with vaginal bleeding at 10 weeks of gestation. Ultrasound shows a “snowstorm” pattern with no identifiable fetus. She is diagnosed with a complete hydatidiform mole. Which of the following patterns of fertilization is most consistent with this condition?

30 yearold female 6week postpartum. Looking for an effective contraceptives. She is brestfeeding. She has a history of migranes headaches with aura and has been given carbamazepine. She also have concerns woith delayed fertility.
“หมอครับ พอเห็นผู้หญิงแล้วรู้สึกเฉยๆ แต่พอเห็นผู้ชายแล้วอยากมีเพศสัมพันธ์กับผู้ชายผมปกติหรือเปล่า?” What is the most appropriate response?

choices.A: Normal — it is just sexual orientation
choices.B: Normal — it is just gender identity

questions.stem: A 20-year-old woman presents with persistent vaginal dryness for more than 6 months. She reports significant distress related to this problem and discomfort during sexual activity. She has normal sexual desire and is able to achieve orgasm. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A 25-year-old man reports that he becomes sexually aroused by secretly observing his neighbor undressing through the window. He does not seek physical contact and has no desire to expose himself. Which of the following is the most appropriate term for this behavior?

A 29-year-old man reports that for the past 8 months, he consistently ejaculates within approximately 1 minute of vaginal penetration. He feels distressed about the situation and reports relationship difficulties. He has normal erectile function and normal sexual desire. Which of the following is the most appropriate diagnosis?

A 28-year-old married man presents with concerns about his sexual performance. For the past 8 months, he has consistently ejaculated within approximately 45 seconds of vaginal penetration. He reports feeling frustrated and embarrassed, and the condition has caused significant tension in his relationship. He denies erectile difficulties. Which of the following is the most likely diagnosis?

A 13-year-old boy prefers dressing in traditionally feminine clothing. He reports that he is comfortable being male and does not feel distress about his gender identity. He also does not experience significant impairment in social or academic functioning. Which of the following best describes this presentation?
